clips.text: هل يمكنك أن تأخذني في جولة في أرجاء مبنى البرلمان؟
Can you give me a tour of the Parliament grounds?
What you are looking at is The Peace Tower.
ما تنظر إليه هو برج السلام (Peace Tower) في أوتاوا.
Would you like to know more about the history or architecture?
هل تود معرفة المزيد عن التاريخ أو الهندسة المعمارية؟
Tell me more about the artist of this painting.
Cuéntame más sobre el artista de esta pintura del museo.
Stormy Weather, Georgian Bay is a famous 1921 oil painting by Canadian artist and Group of Seven founding member F.H. Varley.
Stormy Weather, Georgian Bay es un famoso óleo de 1921 del artista canadiense y miembro fundador del Grupo de los Siete, F.H. Varley.
Poutine is a classic Quebec dish!
Poutine（起司肉汁薯條）是起源於加拿大魁北克省的國民級經典美食！
It contains three main elements: French fries, cheese curds, and rich gravy.
它包含三個主要元素：薯條、起司塊（Cheese Curds）、濃郁肉汁（Gravy）。
La poutine est un plat classique du Québec !

ambience.text: Gentle autumn park ambience in Ottawa: soft wind rustling through dry maple leaves, a distant calm river, occasional quiet bird calls far away. Calm and peaceful, steady and loopable. No voices, no music, no traffic.
